Name: bDynaSep
Comment: Dynamic TCP separation monitoring between robots

Name: bSepAll
Comment: TRUE = monitor ALL pairs, FALSE = only pairs sharing a zone

Name: rSlowDist
Comment: Separation thresholds [mm]: below rSlowDist the lower-priority robot is slowed (linear ramp), below rStopDist it is frozen.

Name: aiPriority
Comment: Service priority per robot: 1 = highest. Ties break by robot id. 1..GC_ROBOTS

Name: arZoneLim
Comment: Zone speed limits [0.1..1.0], 1.0 = full speed (transfer areas) 1..GC_ZONES
